# RCSB mmCIF Snapshot

This directory contains a local snapshot of the official RCSB/wwPDB `mmcif`
Python package for planned PDBx/mmCIF input support in SASMOL.

## Snapshot

- Package: `mmcif`
- Version: `1.1.1`
- Source: PyPI source distribution, `mmcif-1.1.1.tar.gz`
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/rcsb/py-mmcif
- Project homepage: https://mmcif.wwpdb.org
- License reported by package metadata: Apache-2.0
- Download date: 2026-06-11
- Snapshot SHA256:
  `00f7075a824a90f9148f209e5dd1907cdb9e4329357b3ae55e664e6d37dadafd`

The full upstream source distribution is preserved as
`mmcif-1.1.1.tar.gz`. The extracted `mmcif-1.1.1/` directory contains the
Python package plus upstream license and package metadata needed for local
development. The source distribution also includes C/C++ support modules; those
remain available in the tarball and were not fully expanded here to avoid
adding unrelated build/test material to the working tree.

Before public redistribution, review the repository-wide license plan and
confirm that the bundled Apache-2.0 package is handled consistently with the
chosen distribution license.
